title: Holomorphic source asymptotics and volume limits for strict Conway compositions
status: Draft; nonzero whole-invariant asymptotic and volume limit for every fixed strict expression with at least two leaves and independently long fixed signed powers
imports: Exact Newton turn, trace, products, colored circles and crossing polynomial from Newton calculus and stationary profiles of Conway tangles, Proposition 3.2, Theorem 3.3, Proposition 4.1 and equation (4.8); reduced Kashaev normalization from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Theorem 10.1.

The primitive wire lattice and strict optimizer from Newton calculus and stationary profiles of Conway tangles, Lemma 6.1 and Theorem 6.4. Whole physical-color and full-minus-core bounds from Spectral estimates for Conway tangle sources, Theorem 1.1 for at least three leaves and Corollary 9.1 for two, used with retained signs zero.

The entire Fourier filling theorem from Oscillatory filling sums with independently long twists, Theorem 1.1. Primitive metric completion and absolute volume from Marked geometry of strict Conway compositions, Theorem 1.3, with its directly defined classical shear in Section 6.

Canonical factorial interpolation, the strict pure window, shared Fourier bounds, exact full-power expansion and absolute shear comparison are proved here. The signed local coefficient and completed-root source theorems remain separate exports, not premises of the enlarged volume route. Net-twist reductions and moving-meridian conclusions are not asserted.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
